info.name: Hashnode Clone — Phase 2 API Verification
info.description: Run after starting MongoDB and the Express API. The collection creates two test accounts and one reusable test tag, then exercises the core PRD APIs plus the additional social API routes. It cleans up its test posts, comments and post relationships. The two test accounts and the tag remain in MongoDB intentionally. Import into Postman and run requests in order. Dynamic timestamp email values allow repeated runs.

exec: const body = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set("firstToken", body.token); pm.collectionVariables.set("firstUserId", body.user.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("firstUsername", body.user.username); pm.test("Password hash is not exposed", function () { pm.expect(body.user.password).to.be.undefined; });

request.description: The same normalized email must not create another account.

exec: pm.test("Duplicate registration is rejected", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });

const body = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set("secondToken", body.token); pm.collectionVariables.set("secondUserId", body.user.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("secondUsername", body.user.username);
pm.test("Login returns a JWT and safe user", function () { pm.expect(body.token).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(body.user.password).to.be.undefined; });
pm.test("Invalid credentials return HTTP 401", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test("Current account is first user", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.user.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("firstUserId")); });

item.name: Reject protected request with invalid token

exec: const post = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set("publishedPostId", post.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("publishedPostSlug", post.slug); pm.test("Published post has required values", function () { pm.expect(post.status).to.eql("published"); pm.expect(post.tags.length).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: Public feed never returns draft records

exec: pm.test("Draft id is absent from public feed", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.some((post) => post.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("draftId"))).to.eql(false); });
pm.test("Search returns matching title", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.some((post) => post.title.includes("API Verification"))).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Public article includes markdown body", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.content).to.be.a("string"); });

pm.test("My posts contain draft and published records", function () { const s = pm.response.json().data.map((post) => post.status); pm.expect(s).to.include("draft"); pm.expect(s).to.include("published"); });
pm.test("Draft body can be empty", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql("draft"); });

Other user cannot retrieve my draft

request.description: Creates a separate private draft so draft deletion can be tested without changing the earlier draft-to-published test.

item.name: Creating same tag again reuses it

exec: pm.test("Duplicate tag reuses the same record", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("tagId")); });
pm.test("Public profile omits email", function () { const user = pm.response.json().data.user; pm.expect(user.email).to.be.undefined; });
pm.test("Public profile returns only published posts", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.posts.every((post) => post.status === "published")).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Profile data persisted", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.user.name).to.eql("Alex QA Updated"); });
pm.test("Second user is in following list", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.some((user) => user.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("secondUserId"))).to.eql(true); });

item.name: List my followers as second user

exec: pm.test("Duplicate like did not increase count", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.likes).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("likesAfterLike"))); });
pm.test("Bookmarked post is listed", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.some((post) => post.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("publishedPostId"))).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("Root comment includes replies array", function () { const root = pm.response.json().data.find((comment) => comment.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("commentId")); pm.expect(root.replies.length).to.be.above(0); });
